name: lab_pose_pop
description: Lab room, position pop detector. At 5 s the host's player jumps 1500 units in one frame inside Doc Mitchell's house (coop teleport; under the 4000 unit teleport distance, so the stream carries no teleport flag). The guest draws the host's avatar from the replicated stream, and its glitch watch (coop_session::glitch, the same code the viewer runs) must count a pop. The detectors read the drawn position, heading and animation id, not rendered pixels.
